title: Hot and sour soup with tofu, shiitake and egg
steps: Cut the tofu into strips, slice the mushrooms, cut the carrot into fine sticks and grate the ginger.
Bring the stock to the boil, simmer the mushrooms, carrot and ginger for 5 minutes, then add the tofu.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, chilli and pepper, mix the cornflour with 3 tbsp cold water and stir it in until the soup thickens slightly.
Pour in the beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring and serve with sesame oil and spring onions.
